result_summary.title: Billing Discrepancies in Sandbox: Chargebacks, Tax Errors, and Undercharges
result_summary.description: We are testing the Payment Gateway v2 sandbox environment in US-East and encountering multiple billing inaccuracies. We are receiving chargeback notices for valid transactions, the calculated tax amounts are incorrect, and some transactions are resulting in undercharges. This affects our compliance testing workflow for 43 users and has a moderate business impact as we cannot validate our invoicing logic.
